channel.title: Redaush Portfolio Updates

item.title: Won Second Spelling Bee Award
item.description: Represented my school and won both group and individual Spelling Bee competitions for the second consecutive year on May 15, 2026.

item.title: STUDCON26 Motivational Speech
item.description: Delivered an inspiring motivational speech on youth leadership and IT innovation at the STUDCON26 conference from April 27-30, 2026.

item.title: fModLoader v1.0.4 Beta Released
item.description: Released fModLoader v1.0.4 Beta ('Project Vectoris') featuring a built-in vector glyph editor canvas, 13 drawing tools, and SVG import capabilities on April 25, 2026.

item.title: Won First Public Speaking Award
item.description: Won first place in the High Up Academy Public Speaking Competition on April 24, 2026.

item.title: 1-Year Anniversary at High Up Academy

item.title: fModLoader v1.0.1 Beta Launched on GitHub
item.description: Initial public release of fModLoader on GitHub on April 10, 2026 — an open-source font glyph modification utility built with PyQt6.

item.title: Elite Meet with Dr. Khalid Hajji
